text: Bros I don die!! See wetin Chidi post for status 😂😂😂 my belle dey pain me
notes: Gloss: 'I've died' = I'm dying of laughter; belly hurts from laughing. Death idiom, no distress.

text: NEPA don take light again?? Na so I go dey sweat till morning, dem wan kill me for this country 😤
notes: Gloss: Power cut again; I'll sweat till morning; they want to kill me. Frustration at the grid, 'kill me' is hyperbole.

text: Wetin you cook today? I dey come your side, make you keep me food abeg
notes: Gloss: What did you cook? I'm coming over, please keep me some food. Everyday chat.

text: This traffic for Lekki go finish me today. I don dey Third Mainland since 5pm, na so e be
notes: Gloss: This Lekki traffic will finish me. Stuck on Third Mainland since 5pm. Traffic venting, 'finish me' is hyperbole.

text: Guy that Man U match nearly send me go meet my ancestors 😭 3-3!! Heart no strong for this one
notes: Gloss: That match nearly sent me to meet my ancestors; 3-3; my heart can't take it. Football drama.

text: Abeg how I go take buy MTN data with my bank app? Dem dey show me error since morning
notes: Gloss: How do I buy MTN data with my bank app? It's been showing errors since morning. Practical chat.

text: Omo body dey tire me. This work no get end. I just wan sleep for like 3 days straight
notes: Gloss: I'm worn out; work has no end; I want to sleep for 3 days. Tiredness.

text: Money don finish again and salary still far. E no easy at all
notes: Gloss: Money finished again, payday far away, it's not easy. Money worry.

text: I dey miss my people for village. Lagos dey lonely small sha
notes: Gloss: I miss my people back home; Lagos is a bit lonely. Mild sadness.

text: My head dey hot with this exam wahala. I never read anything and e dey worry me
notes: Gloss: Exam trouble has my head hot; I haven't studied and it's worrying me. Stress.

text: Dem don owe me three months salary. I dey try pretend say I dey fine for house but my mind no dey rest
notes: Gloss: Three months of unpaid salary; I'm pretending to be fine at home but my mind isn't at rest. Stress, hiding it.

text: I no fit again o. Every day na the same story. I just dey drag this life
notes: Gloss: I can't anymore; same story every day; I'm just dragging this life along. 'I no fit again' + 'drag this life' = exhaustion shading into hopelessness.

text: My papa and mama dey stress for my matter. Sometimes I dey think say e for better for dem if I no dey burden dem again
notes: Gloss: My parents are stressed over me; sometimes I think it'd be better for them if I stopped being a burden. Perceived burdensomeness.

text: God when? I don pray and pray, nothing dey move. I don tire to dey hope
notes: Gloss: God, when? I've prayed and prayed, nothing moves; I'm tired of hoping. Religious framing of hopelessness.

text: Nobody dey call me again. If I disappear tomorrow wetin go change?
notes: Gloss: Nobody calls me anymore; if I disappear tomorrow, what would change? Isolation + 'disappear' (passive wish to not be here).

text: Everybody dey move, I dey one place. I don dey feel like I no get use for anywhere
notes: Gloss: Everyone is moving ahead, I'm stuck; I feel I'm no use anywhere. Worthlessness, understated.

Bro I'm DEAD 😭😭 did you see the video of that pastor's wig falling off? I can't breathe
notes: Gloss: Literal English slang for laughing hard. Hard negative: 'dead', 'can't breathe'.

text: lol my landlord said he'll 'kill me' if I don't pay by Friday, he's been saying that since 2023 😂
notes: Gloss: Landlord's running joke about killing me over rent; I find it funny. Hard negative: 'kill me' is a known figure of speech.

text: Heading to the market now, anything you want me to get for you? Garri, pepper, tomatoes?
notes: Gloss: Everyday chat.

text: Honestly I'm just tired, work has been a lot and my oga no dey let me breathe
notes: Gloss: Work stress; my boss gives me no room to breathe.

text: Exams are killing me this semester, I haven't slept properly in days, e no easy
notes: Gloss: Exam stress; 'killing me' is hyperbole. Hard negative: low level, sounds worse than it is.

text: Been feeling kind of sad lately for no reason. Maybe na the stress of this country sha
notes: Gloss: Low mood I put down to the stress of life here.

text: I'm honestly tired of pretending to be okay. Every day na the same thing, I just dey act fine for everybody
notes: Gloss: Tired of faking fine. Masking + exhaustion.

text: I feel like I'm a burden to everyone, even my own people. Maybe dem go dey calmer without my wahala
notes: Gloss: Feel like a burden; they'd be calmer without my trouble. Burdensomeness, understated.

text: I don't see the point anymore. Nothing dey change, I dey try but nothing dey work. God abeg
notes: Gloss: No point; trying and nothing works; God please. Hopelessness + prayer.

text: I've stopped replying people. I don't want anybody to see me like this. I just dey disappear small small
notes: Gloss: Withdrawing from everyone; slowly disappearing. Isolation. 'Disappear' here could be social or worse.

text: I can't do this life thing again, I'm so tired. If only I could just sleep and not think anymore
notes: Gloss: Can't do life anymore; wish I could sleep and stop thinking. Escape wish, passive.

text: Everybody around me is moving forward and I'm just here. I feel like a failure and I don't think I'll ever be anything
notes: Gloss: Everyone advancing, I'm stuck; failure; no future. Hopelessness about the future.

notes: Gloss: 'Ara mi o ya' = I'm not feeling well. Tiredness/stress.

text: Mo ti re mi o. School, work, family, everything is too much this week. I just need rest
notes: Gloss: 'Mo ti re mi' = I'm tired. Overload; asks for rest (ordinary).

text: Mo ti re mi lopolopo. Ko si ireti mo ri bayi. Nobody even asks if I'm okay anymore
notes: Gloss: I'm very tired; I see no hope now; nobody asks if I'm okay. Hopelessness + isolation.
